pins.reviews/L0-freeze-reconciliation.json: owner announcement, read as context only

blindness_attestation: No reviews/L0-*.json verdict authored by another reviewer was read before this plan and the verdict file were written. Only the owner's L0-freeze-reconciliation.json (an announcement, not a verdict) and the artifact's own docs were read.
sample_rule_pre_registered: For each frozen class C in [AF-WCC-VAC-GEN, AF-SCC-C2-VAC-GEN, AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN, AF-WCC-SCALAR-SPH], take the first ledger row in file order whose class_ids == [C] exactly, and among its source_ids take the first source with evidence_type in (abstract, full-text). Additionally take the sole row with verification_status == unverified and its first source. Deduplicate by source_id. This yields 5 sources.

acceptance_rule_pre_registered.locator_resolves: HTTP 200 AND the returned title matches the audit title by exact normalized substring or >= 0.8 token overlap
acceptance_rule_pre_registered.scope_consistent: the fetched abstract/record does not visibly contradict the ledger row's statement_exact or assumptions; a paywalled page that shows title/authors/venue and no abstract is recorded as metadata-consistent, not scope-verified
acceptance_rule_pre_registered.hard_failure: any sampled locator that does not resolve (non-200 / wrong work / dead identifier), or >=2 samples whose title does not match
acceptance_rule_pre_registered.report_rule: record per-sample raw evidence URL, fetched_at, http status, matched title, and scope note; report the count of scope-verified vs metadata-consistent samples

falsifier: A later re-measurement showing the ledger or citation-audit sha256 differs from the pins above, a sampled locator that resolves to a different work, or a repaired ledger whose verification_status derivation changes voids or supersedes this review without refuting its measured content.
